title: yian.cli.v1
description: The documents yian's --json commands write. A command writes exactly one JSON object and a newline on stdout, and nothing else there. Every document has "format": "yian.cli.v1". Keys are snake_case. Every key a document lists is always present (null where it allows null). Consumers ignore unknown keys; keys are only added within v1. Message and note text is not part of the contract, nor are the number and order of `config check` errors; codes and fields are. Numbers use yian's lossless JSON form: a float always has a fraction or an exponent (2.0), an int never does. Exit codes: 0 success; 1 a reported problem, with its document on stdout; 2 a usage error (text on stderr, no document); 130 stopped by SIGINT (no document). Any other exit, a crash included (exit 1 with a traceback), has no document; a consumer treats stdout that doesn't parse as an internal error. stderr is free-form.

frame.description: A source location: range is [start_line, start_col, end_line, end_col], 1-based with an exclusive end column. note is left out when empty.

diagnostic.description: A problem with a code, a message and its source frames, outermost first. frames and notes are left out when empty.

error_document.description: Written by a --json command that exits 1 without its own result document.

input.description: One declared flow input. type is the canonical type label (int, Optional(str), a typedef expanded as {"age":int,"name":str}).

flow_result.description: One flow `yian check` loaded; path is the argument exactly as given.

check_document.description: `yian check --json`: one result per flow argument, in argument order.
